# Memory Map — full agent brief

Private, browser-local analysis of a ChatGPT export into evidence-linked memory and longitudinal insights.

## Index

# Memory Map

Private, browser-local analysis of a ChatGPT export.

## What it does

- Parses the official export ZIP in the browser
- Builds evidence-linked activity, topic, repeat, and change views
- Keeps conversations away from an application server
- Offers optional browser-local semantic models and Memory Chat

## Agent entrypoints

- https://chatgpt.significanthobbies.com/llms.txt
- https://chatgpt.significanthobbies.com/api/ai

## Product and commercial boundaries

- The archive and derived memory stay in the person's browser.
- Public machine surfaces are read-only documentation, not a hosted archive-analysis API.
- The current web app has no Memory Map account or checkout; the portfolio has not declared a permanent free or paid model.
- Site-level page-view and performance telemetry is separate and receives no archive text or derived content.
